_contract: The approval for ONE real-GPU engineering validation of the Phase-C2 full-joint-search driver. Recorded HERE, under this validation's own governance evidence, and deliberately NOT in any formal C2 artifact: it permits an engineering observation and confers nothing on the scientific search.
granted_by: the maintainer decision of 2026-09-17 closing the Phase-C2 preparation round, whose execution sequence requires 'one bounded real-GPU engineering validation of the full-search path sufficient to exercise the CUDA/device/BF16/model-materialization integration that the CPU toy run cannot verify' before any formal scientific search. That decision approved the validation and stated no dollar amount, so the amount is derived and bounded here — P12.1 requires an engineering validation to have a stated budget and scope, and each task's amounts live in that task's governance artifact.
subject: real-CUDA engineering validation of scripts/pod/autoinit_phase_c2_full_search_driver.py

scope_is_narrow_and_why.finding: all six implementations the joint space searches ALREADY have real-L40S evidence from paid sessions — 14/2/19/6/29/38 expansions across Phase-B attempt 5 and C2 attempt 4 — each a real plan/apply/materialize/canonical reload/identity/state_eval against the real 4B teacher. Phase B also ran with impl_profiles=None over two mixtures, which is the joint search's own unpinned branching. So operator device placement, dtype handling and real-scale materialization are evidenced, and re-running them would cost hours without answering a question.
scope_is_narrow_and_why.what_is_actually_unverified: THIS DRIVER has never run on a GPU. Its stage sequencing, its afford check, the arguments it forwards to run_phase_a_search, its commit_top_k parsing and its pod-side path resolution are exercised only by a CPU toy execution — which already found one real defect in that wrapper.
scope_is_narrow_and_why.so_the_validation_is: the driver itself, on one real L40S, at toy geometry with --device cuda and bf16, through the real BeamSearch over the full joint space, with DEVICE PLACEMENT and DTYPE asserted; plus one real-geometry student materialization and canonical-reload probe, which needs the teacher's config at the pinned revision and NOT its weights.

resource_contract._why_the_target_card: the card the formal search will use. Validating device integration on a different card would leave the real one unverified, which is the failure this validation exists to prevent.
resource_contract._price_basis_is_re_quoted: the launcher queries the live securePrice and refuses above the basis. An hour-old price is not a price.
resource_contract._teardown_reserve: WITHIN the $0.90 ceiling, not added to it.
resource_contract._minute_budgets_follow_the_rate: $0.60/rate is the work stop and $0.90/rate the hard limit, so a dearer GPU buys proportionally less time: 33.0 and 49.5 minutes at $1.09/h.
resource_contract._amendment_2026_09_17: The count-based clauses {"provider_create_attempts_max": 1, "provider_resources_max": 1, "retries_or_replacement_pods": 0} are WITHDRAWN by the maintainer decision of 2026-09-17, prospectively, on the standing rule that ATTEMPT COUNT IS NOT BUDGET. A $0 create failure, a cold or unusable host, or an ordinary provider transient must not force another maintainer round merely because it was 'attempt 1' -- the cumulative ceiling is what bounds this validation, and it is unchanged. What replaces them is a SAFETY boundary rather than a counter: one BILLING resource at any instant, and a replacement only after the previous one is provider-confirmed gone.
hard_constraints: total validation spend across EVERY draw, resource and retry <= $0.9000 -- cumulative, reset by nothing
soft work stop at $0.6000: stop starting new work, with the teardown reserve INSIDE the ceiling and never added to it
only an NVIDIA L40S meeting the declared capability requirement; no other card, no substitution to make a cheaper device pass
live securePrice <= $1.09/h, re-quoted immediately before each draw; a rate above it needs a new maintainer budget decision, not a price chase
at most ONE BILLING resource at any instant
a replacement or redraw only after the previous resource is PROVIDER-CONFIRMED gone -- confirmed by query, never by a delete call returning
every draw and every cost is recorded, including $0 draws, and the cumulative total is recomputed from those components rather than carried forward
no scope expansion: the subject, dtype, card and workload above are the whole validation
resource_contract._retries_are_bounded_by_money_not_by_cou: An ordinary pre-measurement failure -- provider transient, cold host, or a deterministic engineering defect the validation exposes -- is diagnosed, minimally repaired, minimally retested and rerun autonomously for as long as the SAME $0.9000 cumulative ceiling still funds a useful attempt plus the teardown reserve. The ceiling is never expanded to fund a retry. Repeating an identical failure unchanged is not a repair.

capability_requirement._why: the driver runs bf16 because that is what the formal search runs; bf16 needs cc >= 8.0. The dtype, the operator set and the workload must NOT be changed to make a cheaper unsupported device pass.

authorizes: one real-CUDA engineering validation of the full-search driver, at the stated resource, capability and budget contract
autonomous diagnosis, minimal repair and minimal retest of ORDINARY engineering failures inside this envelope, per the maintainer's step 3 and P12.1, without a further approval
does_not_authorize: the formal Phase-C2 full joint search
any formal C2 grant, authorization, readiness record or bundle
the behavioural screening or confirmation session
a Search-1 rerun, or remeasurement of B or any frozen C candidate
C3 or C4 work of any kind
spending C1's $6.0000 engineering allowance, which belongs to C1's package and does not transfer
more than one BILLING resource at any instant, or a replacement before the previous resource is provider-confirmed gone
any draw, retry or repair that would carry cumulative validation spend past $0.9000, or that would raise that ceiling

budget_context._it_comes_from_the_project_envelope: not from C1's engineering allowance, which is that package's and does not transfer. The arithmetic above shows the C2 chain still fits after this validation's worst case.
budget_context._note: feasibility arithmetic, not permission to execute the formal search

formal_c2_status_unchanged: the full joint search remains NOT AUTHORIZED. This validation produces engineering evidence for a later launch review and nothing else; its report carries scientific_use: false.
stop_and_report_only_if: the budget or the scope would have to change
resource billing cannot be reconciled, or ownership of a resource is uncertain
the target hardware or rate contract would have to change
frozen scientific evidence would have to change
the validation uncovers something that changes the formal C2 scientific protocol
_not_a_stop_condition: another ordinary engineering failure, or the fact that a draw was 'the first one'. Per P12.1 and the maintainer's step 3, those are diagnosed and repaired inside this envelope without a further approval.
